title: Liquid AI Launches LFM3 Foundation Models for Specialized Edge AI
summary:
Liquid AI has released its latest generation of small foundation models, known as LFM3, designed to deliver specialized artificial intelligence directly on edge devices. The suite comprises six model instances across text, audio, vision, and decision modalities, featuring a 2B parameter vision-language model and an audio model capable of reasoning in 18 languages. The LFM3-VL-2B is designed to compete with significantly larger models, including the 12B parameter Gemma 4.

The family utilizes a tri-hybrid architecture optimized for 14 processor classes, including NPUs, CPUs, and GPUs, and is compatible with a 256K context window. The smallest text model, LFM3-1.7B, can fit in roughly 1 GB of memory at 4-bit quantization and uses 35% fewer parameters than the previous LFM2.5-2.6B model while improving performance. The models can be fine-tuned on a single GPU and launched with day-0 support from the SGLang project.
